oracle_crosscheck.method: owned task command writes /var/lib/nodesteer-qa-pcond-<nonce>/markers/<key>.marker with its own UTC timestamp; harness deletes the marker after each readback, so presence after a run proves this execution executed. Marker timestamp must fall inside [start_time-3s, end_time+30s].
oracle_crosscheck.conclusion: no side effect for unsatisfied/blocked conditions; every satisfied condition produced a genuine on-node side effect.

defects_confirmed.summary: Remote conditions are always UNKNOWN -> BLOCKED in this environment. Independently re-measured in this batch: repair Hub clock is ahead of the native-1 agent clock by a median of +0.1464s (12 interleaved samples, range 0.086-0.150), so the Hub-provided observed_at is always in the agent's future and validRemoteState rejects it.
defects_confirmed.not_claimed: 未修改任何产品源码；未主张修复方案与阈值。

observations.severity: medium (coverage/design dead branch, not claimed as a defect)
observations.summary: Hub 远程状态缓存分支在当前代码中不可达：SetRemoteState 的唯一调用点是 gateway.handleRemoteState（处理 Agent 上报的 MsgRemoteState），但仓库中没有任何 Agent 侧发送 MsgRemoteState 的代码路径。因此 resolveRemoteState 的缓存命中分支永远不成立，"TTL 过期"维度无法通过真实产品路径构造。
observations.verification: code read: internal/hub/gateway.go:570 (SetRemoteState), grep MsgRemoteState across repository -> only inbound handlers in agent/connection/manager.go:357 and hub/gateway.go:261, no sender.

observations.severity: low (behaviour as implemented; semantics arguably surprising)
observations.summary: file_exists / dir_exists / process_exists / port_listening 的 actual 值为 "true"/"false"，但 Hub 校验器允许全部 6 个 operator；>、<、>=、<= 走 numericCompare 的非数值回退（字典序字符串比较），因此 "file_exists > false" 会判定为满足。已在真实执行中观测（PC-FILE-05/06 等 6 条）。未主张为缺陷。
observations.verification: observed real executions; code read internal/agent/condition/engine.go:232-264 (compare / numericCompare) and internal/hub/validation.go:96.
